description: Invented software-team memories and independently worded questions. One annotated relevant slug per query; semantically adjacent distractors are deliberately retained. Fixed corpus, no private data. Evaluation set, not a held-out generalization claim.

memories.title: npm trusted publishing (OIDC)
memories.body: The registry accepts short-lived identity claims from the approved CI workflow. A protected version tag triggers the package publication job after validation. Do not store long-lived registry credentials.

memories.title: Release validation checklist
memories.body: Before creating a version tag, run type checking, linting, unit tests, coverage and a packed consumer installation. Both supported runtimes must pass the same thresholds.

memories.title: Deployment rollback procedure
memories.body: Retain the previous immutable container image digest. If a rollout causes errors, restore that digest and verify the health endpoint before resuming traffic.

memories.title: Semantic version policy
memories.body: An incompatible public API change requires a major version. New compatible functionality is minor and a compatible defect correction is patch.

memories.title: Changelog generation
memories.body: Build release notes from tracked work items and version boundaries. Regenerate the text after tracker changes and require the generated output to match in CI.

memories.title: Canary deployment
memories.body: Send a small fraction of requests to a candidate instance. Compare latency and failure ratios before expanding the rollout to every instance.

memories.title: Database schema migrations
memories.body: Apply additive schema changes before deploying code that uses them. Destructive column removal waits until old application instances have drained.

memories.title: Postgres backup verification
memories.body: Nightly logical dumps are encrypted and retained off-site. A scheduled restore into an isolated database verifies table counts and representative queries.

memories.title: Database connection pooling
memories.body: Set a bounded pool per process and reserve connections for administrative recovery. The sum across replicas must stay below the database connection limit.

memories.title: Query index selection
memories.body: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a representative read. Add a selective index when scans dominate cost, then measure write overhead and the execution plan again.

memories.title: Atomic database updates
memories.body: Related writes belong in a transaction. Commit only after every invariant passes; otherwise roll back the entire unit of work.

memories.title: Deadlock retry policy
memories.body: Acquire row locks in consistent order. Retry serialization and deadlock failures with a bounded jittered backoff around the entire transaction.

memories.title: HTTP retry safety
memories.body: Retry transient network failures only for idempotent operations or requests carrying a stable idempotency key. Bound attempts and use exponential jitter.

memories.title: Outbound request deadlines
memories.body: Each downstream call has a finite timeout shorter than the incoming request deadline. Abort outstanding work when the caller disconnects.

memories.title: API rate limiting
memories.body: Return status 429 with Retry-After when a client exceeds its token bucket. Separate authenticated tenant quotas and cap bursts.

memories.title: Cursor pagination
memories.body: List endpoints return a stable opaque continuation token. Consumers must follow tokens until none remains rather than guessing page numbers.

memories.title: Conditional HTTP responses
memories.body: Send ETag for immutable representations and honor If-None-Match with status 304. Vary the cache key by every negotiated representation header.

memories.title: Webhook authentication
memories.body: Verify the HMAC over the original request bytes using a constant-time comparison. Reject stale timestamps and deduplicate event identifiers.

memories.title: Secret management
memories.body: Applications read sensitive values from a dedicated vault at runtime. Repository files and logs contain only references and never credential values.

memories.title: Credential rotation
memories.body: Introduce the replacement credential, verify consumers have switched, then revoke the old credential. Keep the overlap short and audit every transition.

memories.title: Cross-site request forgery defense
memories.body: State-changing browser requests require an origin check and a session-bound CSRF token. SameSite cookies provide additional protection.

memories.title: HTML injection prevention
memories.body: Escape untrusted text at the rendering boundary. Sanitize intentional rich markup with a small allowlist and enforce a restrictive content security policy.

memories.title: Filesystem traversal defense
memories.body: Resolve user-supplied file names under an explicit allowed root. Refuse traversal components and symbolic links that escape that boundary.

memories.title: SQL injection prevention
memories.body: Use bound parameters for data values. Select dynamic identifiers from a fixed allowlist rather than concatenating user input into statements.

memories.title: Log redaction
memories.body: Structured application logs omit authorization headers, cookies and personal message bodies. Test redaction with synthetic sensitive fixtures.

memories.title: Least privilege roles
memories.body: Grant service identities only the operations they need. Separate administrative and runtime accounts and audit permission changes.

memories.title: OpenID Connect login
memories.body: Validate issuer, audience, signature and expiry of identity tokens. Bind authorization code responses to the initiating browser using state and PKCE.

memories.title: Browser session cookies
memories.body: Use Secure, HttpOnly cookies with explicit SameSite settings. Regenerate the session identifier after authentication and privilege elevation.

memories.title: Password hashing
memories.body: Store salted Argon2id password hashes with calibrated memory and time cost. Never encrypt passwords for later recovery or store plaintext.

memories.title: Account recovery
memories.body: Password reset links are random, short-lived and single-use. Respond uniformly whether an account exists and invalidate sessions after a successful reset.

memories.title: Multi-factor authentication
memories.body: Prefer passkeys or hardware security keys. Offer recovery codes once and store their hashes; require fresh verification for sensitive changes.

memories.title: Session revocation
memories.body: Signing out invalidates the server-side session and expires the browser cookie. A stolen session must remain invalid on subsequent requests.

memories.title: Readiness probe
memories.body: The traffic gate checks whether the process can serve requests, including essential dependencies. A failing readiness check removes the replica from routing.

memories.title: Liveness probe
memories.body: The watchdog checks process responsiveness rather than transient downstream availability. Repeated failures restart a stuck process.

memories.title: Graceful shutdown
memories.body: On termination stop accepting new work, drain active requests within a deadline, then close pools and exit. Queue jobs must become retryable.

memories.title: Disk reserve guard
memories.body: Pause large staging operations before free capacity falls below the configured reserve. Never remove unrelated files automatically to make space.

memories.title: Actionable alert policy
memories.body: Page only on user-visible symptoms with an owner and a runbook. Group correlated notifications and tune thresholds using measured service objectives.

memories.title: Distributed request tracing
memories.body: Propagate trace context between services and correlate spans with structured logs. Sample successful requests and retain representative failures.

memories.title: Latency histograms
memories.body: Record request durations in histogram buckets and compare tail percentiles over fixed windows. Averages alone hide a small set of very slow responses.

memories.title: Load test capacity
memories.body: Use representative traffic and gradually increase concurrency. Record saturation, error rate and tail latency instead of extrapolating from health checks.

memories.title: Content-addressed cache
memories.body: Key derived artifacts by source content hash and transformation version. A content edit creates a new entry; timestamps alone cannot establish freshness.

memories.title: Cache stampede prevention
memories.body: Coalesce concurrent misses for the same key and jitter expiration. Allow bounded stale reads during refresh when the consistency contract permits it.

memories.title: At-least-once job delivery
memories.body: Workers acknowledge only after durable completion. Handlers must tolerate duplicate delivery using stable job identifiers and idempotent writes.

memories.title: Poison message handling
memories.body: After bounded attempts move consistently failing jobs to a dead-letter queue with sanitized failure evidence. Operators can inspect and explicitly replay them.

memories.title: Atomic file publication
memories.body: Write to a sibling temporary file, flush required data and rename on the same filesystem. Readers should observe either the previous complete file or the new complete file.

memories.title: Shared writer lock
memories.body: Independent processes modifying the same tracker acquire one shared writer lease around the entire read-modify-write operation. Avoid lost updates.

memories.title: Original media preservation
memories.body: Treat source files as irreplaceable. Probe and hash them read-only; publish converted outputs separately and require explicit retirement approval.

memories.title: Symbolic link safety
memories.body: Inspect links without following them outside the allowed tree. Refuse imports that point to external content and retain the original source.

memories.title: Synthetic test fixtures
memories.body: Use invented records and credential-shaped placeholders in regression tests. Public fixtures must not contain real customer information.

memories.title: Behavioural regression proof
memories.body: Temporarily restore only the changed function and rerun the targeted regression. A passing restored version and failing reverted version establish test sensitivity.

memories.title: Isolated test environments
memories.body: Create temporary trackers with no ancestor discovery and controlled process configuration. Tests must not depend on developer git identity or home settings.

memories.title: Coverage dimensions
memories.body: Measure statements, branches, functions and lines over all intended source files. An unexecuted file must appear in the denominator.

memories.title: Packed consumer acceptance
memories.body: Install the produced package archive into a clean consumer and exercise documented commands. Source-only unit tests cannot establish published entry-point correctness.

memories.title: Deterministic ranking ties
memories.body: Capture a single clock per ranking pass. Break equal scores with stable identifiers so scheduling and loop duration cannot change the order.

memories.title: Keyboard navigation
memories.body: Every interactive control has a visible focus indicator and can be reached in logical tab order. Dialogs restore focus when dismissed.

memories.title: Reduced motion preference
memories.body: Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling nonessential transitions. Keep state changes understandable without relying on animation.

memories.title: Accessible form labels
memories.body: Associate each input with a visible label and connect help and error text with described-by references. Placeholder text is insufficient.

memories.title: Responsive layout
memories.body: Use fluid widths with bounded readable text and let grids collapse at content-driven breakpoints. Avoid horizontal scrolling on narrow screens.

memories.title: Image loading policy
memories.body: Specify dimensions to reserve layout space and defer offscreen media. The primary above-the-fold image should load eagerly.

memories.title: Recoverable form errors
memories.body: Keep submitted input when validation fails and place a clear error beside the relevant field. Offer a retry path for transient failures.

memories.title: Version tag discipline
memories.body: Create annotated version tags only for verified commits. Do not retarget a tag already consumed by the release workflow.

memories.title: Pull request review
memories.body: Describe the concrete trigger, resulting behavior and exact validation evidence. Unavailable automated reviewers provide no approval evidence.

memories.title: Explicit staging
memories.body: Stage intended source paths explicitly and inspect the staged diff. Keep generated caches and binary artifacts out of version control.

memories.title: Tracker independence
memories.body: Knowledge items, recall and consolidation operate in a plain directory. Source-control integration is optional and must not be required to read context.
